Model questions

QES15/E FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the QES15/E?

The stated rated capacity is 1,500 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the QES15/E?

The listed lift specification is 3,000 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the QES15/E?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
